scope: Desktop preference/XDG autostart storage foundation only. Tauri commands, GUI, tray host/single instance and lifecycle integration remain open. No user host autostart/configuration was enabled.

desktop_all_targets.ignored_note: Existing180-second synthetic screen-record acceptance is ignored here; not required for storage-only change.

functional_regressions: Defaults read without autostart registration; enable/read/restart/idempotent apply, executable move/disable and stale CAS.
Two independent Store instances serialize by filesystem flock; exactly one competing target-revision update succeeds.
Durable desired settings precede registration; blocked autostart parent surfaces integration error/unknown actual status, then retry repairs registration.
Modified/foreign and even identical-desired preexisting files without recorded ownership are preserved.
Corrupt/unknown/oversized/symlink preference files preserved without default reset or publishing an entry.
System-wide entry stays untouched; disabling writes user Hidden override and reported actual enabled=false; re-enable/disable work.

Real desktop-file-validate and GIO launch on private D-Bus run harmless Python fixture under an executable path containing space/apostrophe/quote/dollar/backtick/backslash/percent; captured argv exactly matches original path and --autostart. No shell.

intermediate_failures.note: GIO rejected a valid desktop file when literal percent was in first executable token. A private matrix isolated percent; fixed Exec to /usr/bin/env -- quoted path, actual argv verified.
New system Hidden override test caught registration incorrectly returning enabled=true. Fixed owned entry readback to respect Hidden=true; final run passed.

not_run: Tauri/GUI/tray/single-instance actual application autostart; next implementation layer.
Exact filesystem IO boundary/resource/foreign concurrent directory replacement matrix.
Full workspace/frontend/native GUI repeats: no shared IPC/runtime/frontend change in this storage-only slice; affected desktop all-targets tested.
Hardware and any new LCD effects.
